properties.name: The allocation question gets its second half
properties.rationale:
THE RESOLUTION OF `dec:idea-does-the-deferred-structuring-step-need-a-skill-of-its-own`, option E: make the absence visible first, decide about a skill later. Anthony chose it 2026-08-25 over three alternatives (a new /allocate skill, extending genesis, extending detect-and-ask).

⚠️ OPTION E'S PREMISE WAS HALF WRONG AND THE CORRECTION IS THE FINDING. E read "nothing notices that a design has capabilities and no components, OR components with no allocation." The first half was already covered — that is `concept_without_design`. Only the second half was real, and it was larger than the option implied: 33 of reflow2's own 95 components are leaf boxes owning no capability, with every detector reporting clean. Checking a stated premise before building on it is what turned a half-true option into a measured one.

WHY LEAF-ONLY IS THE FINDING AND NOT A DETAIL. A parent is allocated through its children, so counting parents would file every well-formed hierarchy as a defect — 40 against 33 on the same design. Note the interaction with the adopt nesting step added the same day (#335): recovering a hierarchy MOVES components off this list by giving them children, which is honest, because a box that groups other boxes has a job.

WHY AGGREGATE, WITH THE LOSING SIDE RECORDED. Per-component keying is the more honest key for the answer people actually give — "this box is a namespace, not a functional part" is a claim about ONE box — and it loses to BL-73 at 33 findings raised at once, because a per-node flood is acknowledged in bulk without being read.

THE THIRD LEG IS WHY THE SKILL ROW SHIPPED WITH THE DETECTOR. `propose_allocation` and `evaluate_allocation` were served, correct, and named in NO skill — the exact shape of `fact:vocabulary-needs-three-legs-and-a-users-project-gets-none-of-it`. A detector that notices the absence without an instruction telling anyone what to do about it would have reproduced the failure it was built to fix, so the detect-and-ask repair table gained the row in the same change.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Added the `unallocated_component` gap: LEAF Components no Capability is ALLOCATED_TO, one aggregate rollup, naming `propose_allocation` as the method. Registered in skill_lint's known terms, docs/gap-surfacing.md, and the detect-and-ask repair table in all three skill mirrors. Nine tests in tests/structure_with_no_function_is_asked_about.rs.
